description: Sum of two unsigned absolute differences: select of two subs not folded to umax - umin
notes: Original combination of two unsigned absolute differences, inspired by the abs-diff pattern of llvm/llvm-project#234884. Candidate: umax(a,b)-umin(a,b) is one IR instruction shorter per difference. Not proven, and fewer IR instructions may not mean faster asm.
